mechanism_evidence.trigger: Explicitly close a live database inside its context using a counting storage implementation.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The method leaves _opened=True, so context exit closes the same storage again.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Mark the database closed before resource cleanup so context exit observes completed ownership release.

discriminating_observation.description:
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
class CountingStorage(MemoryStorage):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.closes=0
 def close(self):self.closes+=1
db=TinyDB(storage=CountingStorage);s=db.storage
with db:
 db.close()
print('database_close_state',s.closes,db._opened)
assert s.closes==1 and not db._opened
